notes.title: Release Patch — New Levels & Languages!
notes.content:
🎯 [h1]Release Patch is Here![/h1]
[b]The full version of The Long Tale comes with new content, fixes, and expanded language support.[/b]

[b]🛠️ What’s new:[/b]
[list]
[*] Full 20-level campaign for the Knight  
[*] 8 Slime levels now available — 12 more coming soon!  
[*] New language support: Korean, Chinese, Japanese  
[*] Bug fixes and improved gamepad support  
[/list]

[i]Thanks for playing and supporting us — more updates are on the way![/i]

[previewyoutube=waaV2l5apCI;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: The Long Tale is Out Now
notes.content:
🎉 [h1]The Long Tale is officially live on Steam![/h1]
[b]Dive into a hardcore pixel platformer where every jump counts, and every trap is out to get you.[/b]

[b]🕹️ Features:[/b]

[list]
[*] Pure 1-bit aesthetics with ruthless level design
[*] Fast respawns, no hand-holding
[*] Secrets to uncover and stars to collect
[*] Controller support and growing community

[/list]
[i]Whether you're here for the pain, the puzzles, or the pixel art — welcome to the tale.
Now go die a hundred times. And love it.[/i]

💬 [b]Share your screenshots, stories, and moments with the community![/b]
📝 [b]Leave a review — it really helps us as a small indie team.[/b]

🔗 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3632420/The_Long_Tale/]Play The Long Tale on Steam[/url]

[previewyoutube=waaV2l5apCI;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Demo Update #1
notes.content:
[h1]⚔️ DEMO UPDATE #1 IS HERE[/h1]

Thanks to your feedback, we've just pushed the first update for *The Long Tale* demo.

[b]What’s new:[/b]
- 🎮 Controller support (finally!)
- 🛠️ UI improvements  
- 🐛 Bug fixes (the spike hitboxes should behave now... mostly)  
- ✨ Minor polish and performance tweaks

[b]Already played the demo?[/b]

Try a new run — it feels better.  
Still haven’t tried it? Now’s the time.

🔗 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3632420/The_Long_Tale/]Play the demo on Steam [/url]

See you in the castle. Again. And again.  
[b]Syrnik Interactive[/b]
